submissions.decision-bundle-conveyor-repairs-into-tw: SELECT a.permit_id AS first_permit, b.permit_id AS second_permit, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.priority_points) FROM repair_request AS r WHERE a.start_hour BETWEEN r.earliest_hour AND r.latest_hour OR b.start_hour BETWEEN r.earliest_hour AND r.latest_hour), 0) AS covered_points FROM stop_permit AS a JOIN stop_permit AS b ON b.start_hour - a.start_hour >= 4 ORDER BY covered_points DESC, a.start_hour, b.start_hour LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-buy-stock-limited-patch-cord-pa: WITH quantities(n) AS (VALUES (0), (1), (2), (3)), options AS (SELECT p.*, q.n FROM pack_offer AS p JOIN quantities AS q ON q.n <= p.stock_limit) SELECT m.n AS mixed_packs, s.n AS short_packs, l.n AS long_packs, m.n*m.price_cents + s.n*s.price_cents + l.n*l.price_cents AS total_cents, t.ticket_id FROM install_ticket AS t CROSS JOIN options AS m CROSS JOIN options AS s CROSS JOIN options AS l WHERE m.pack_code = 'M' AND s.pack_code = 'S' AND l.pack_code = 'L' AND m.n*m.short_qty + s.n*s.short_qty + l.n*l.short_qty >= t.need_short AND m.n*m.long_qty + s.n*s.long_qty + l.n*l.long_qty >= t.need_long ORDER BY total_cents, m.n + s.n + l.n, m.n, s.n, l.n LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-calibrate-clock-from-paired-pun: WITH offsets AS (SELECT reference_s AS t, bench_ms - 1000*reference_s AS o FROM paired_punches), calibration AS (SELECT a.t, a.o, (b.o - a.o)*1000 / (b.t - a.t) AS drift_ppm FROM offsets AS a JOIN offsets AS b ON a.t < b.t) SELECT o - t*drift_ppm/1000 AS initial_offset_ms, drift_ppm FROM calibration
submissions.decision-canonical-circular-etch: WITH RECURSIVE rotations(piece_id, mark, start_offset) AS (SELECT piece_id, mark, 0 FROM etchings UNION ALL SELECT piece_id, mark, start_offset + 1 FROM rotations WHERE start_offset + 1 < length(mark)), readings AS (SELECT piece_id, substr(mark || mark, start_offset + 1, length(mark)) AS canonical_mark, start_offset FROM rotations), ranked AS (SELECT readings.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY piece_id COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY canonical_mark COLLATE BINARY, start_offset) AS rn FROM readings) SELECT piece_id, canonical_mark, start_offset FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY piece_id COLLATE BINARY
